•  Fitia creates a plan that adapts to your goals, lifestyle, preferences, and progress.

INTERMITTENT FASTING TRACKER

AUTOMATIC SHOPPING LIST

• Save time, buy only what you need, and make meal prepping simple and affordable.

FITIA TEAMS
• Stay motivated with friends, coworkers, or family.

PROGRESS TRACKING

APPLE HEALTH SYNC

Your calorie balance updates instantly.

SUPER ERASE (PRO required): Specialized model designed to remove larger distractions. Makes them vanish in a flash, leaving your photos sleek, clean, and distraction-free.

IMAGE ENHANCEMENT: Elevate your photo quality with SnapEdit’s powerful image enhancement tools. Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and more to bring out the hidden details and make your images truly captivating. Enhance colors, sharpen edges, and create a professional finish with ease.

AI Expand: Let you fix your limited framing in one tap. AI Expand will widen backgrounds, fill missing areas, or adjust photo sizes for social media. Create perfectly balanced images that look natural and complete every time.

Replace the background with a solid color, a custom image, or a transparent background for endless creative possibilities.

HIGH-QUALITY RESULTS: SnapEdit utilizes cutting-edge algorithms to deliver high-quality results without compromising on detail or resolution. Your edited photos will retain their clarity and sharpness, ensuring that every detail shines through.

SAVE AND SHARE WITH EASE: Once you’re satisfied with your masterpiece, save your edited photos in high resolution to your device’s gallery. Share your creations directly from the app to social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and more, and impress your friends and followers with your stunning imagery.

Unlock the true potential of your photos with SnapEdit. Download now and experience the power of one-touch object removal, image enhancement, background removal, and an array of artistic filters. Create captivating visuals that leave a lasting impression and showcase your unique vision. Get SnapEdit today and start transforming your photos like a pro!

it.name: RISE: Sleep Tracker
it.d:
Join over 10 million users! Become a better sleeper and morning person thanks to 100 years of sleep science with RISE, the only sleep tracker that also measures your sleep debt and energy levels.

Recommended by the Sleep Foundation and trusted by teams in the NFL, MLB, and NBA, and top Fortune 500 companies, RISE makes it easy to improve your sleep and energy.

But RISE is more than a sleep and energy tracker. Users can access widgets, calendar integration, sleeping sounds, meditation guides, smart alarm clocks, habit reminders, and a sleep knowledge library.

FROM THE RISE COMMUNITY

***
Chase M.
"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."

***
Becky G.
"I could see where sleep debt was causing issues, like temper short, not comprehending things, moving slowly.  I had an epiphany... I'm getting 45min more sleep on average than I was before RISE."


UNLOCK BETTER SLEEP
Tired of the age-old "eight hours of shut-eye" advice? Go beyond buying a new mattress or pillow and discover the life-changing concept of Sleep Debt.

Scientifically proven to be a vital factor in your well-being, a low Sleep Debt can improve your life quality and even your longevity—while high Sleep Debt can cause fatigue and harm your health.

RISE calculates your Sleep Debt, helps you understand its impact on your energy, and guides you on how to lower it by improving sleeping habits. Learn about your melatonin window, when to prioritize sleep, and understand the real cost of those late nights—and how you can benefit from naps.

PERSONALIZED SLEEP TRACKER
Do you find your mind racing when your head hits the pillow? Can’t stop doom-scrolling on your phone? Feeling fatigued all day?

Based on your sleep data, circadian rhythm and research, we’ll make recommendations that fit your needs and guide you toward healthier habits.

RISE will get you in bed on time, guide you when you can’t sleep, reduce the times you wake up at night, and make you feel less groggy in the morning.

DISCOVER YOUR CIRCADIAN RHYTHM
We all have an internal brain clock, our circadian rhythm, it signals to our body when to be alert or go into recovery mode. Everyone is unique, from when we perform our best to when we should sleep and wake up. We use advanced algorithms to find your optimal sleep windows.

You’ll gain insight into your circadian rhythm and energy levels, helping you plan for a productive day.

Sleeping refuels energy, and 83% of RISE users feel more energy in a week or less.

AUTOMATICALLY TRACK SLEEP
Through our integration with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and data from other sleep trackers on your phone, like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye, RISE can determine the hours of sleep you get every night, sleep debt, the number of steps you take each day, as well as data from other activities that affect your sleep pattern.

WHY WE STARTED RISE
We want to help get ahead of the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic (CDC, 2014) we're experiencing, which has been increasing since 1985. This Epidemic has led to elevated mortality rates (Cappuccio, 2010) as well as underperformance in most aspects of life (RAND, 2016).

Today, we look at sleep as a luxury. RISE strives to create a world where healthy sleep is a necessity.

Subscription pricing & terms
RISE offers auto-renewing yearly subscriptions to provide unlimited access to all premium features. There’s also a limited-time free trial of 7 days to explore the premium features for free. A Paid Subscription (or free trial) is required to access the content of the app.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your App Store account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Go to your Profile or App Store settings to manage your subscription.

Terms of Service available at: bit.ly/rise-sleep-app-tos

it.name: Captions: AI Edits Your Video
it.d:
AI EDIT THAT EDITS LIKE A PROFESSIONAL VIDEO EDITOR

Built by Mirage™, Captions is an AI video generator and video editor that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content, no experience needed.

Get started by importing a video or generating engaging content from scratch using text to video. You can create an AI actor or upload a selfie to create a personal avatar, allowing you to produce polished footage of yourself without ever needing to record again. 

From there, skip the hours spent toggling and tweaking manual edits. Our AI video editor applies editorial discernment to cut scenes, overlay B-roll, and integrate sounds based on your video. Whether you polish your video with our AI edit feature or describe desired changes to our chat-based editor, Captions’ intuitive video maker makes it easy to bring your vision to life.


LET AI EDIT FOR YOU

- One-tap AI video editing: Transform raw footage into ready-to-post content instantly with curated effects and trending aesthetics.
- Edit like you text: Just describe your vision in plain language; our chat-based editor will apply effects, transitions, B-roll, and pacing per your direction.


CREATE A PERSONAL AI AVATAR

- AI Twin: Turn a single selfie into a high-quality video of yourself using our AI video generator.
- AI Actors: Generate talking videos with engaging AI avatars, giving you a digital on-brand spokesperson.
- Adjust looks: Change outfits, add objects, and switch backgrounds to feature the same AI avatar across unlimited videos.

Adjust exposure, dial in color, apply filters, all without leaving the app. Edit, compose, and publish in one seamless flow. No switching, no quality lost in transit.

SCRL was designed for creators who think beyond a single post. Build seamless carousels with panoramic layouts, precise alignment, and transitions that flow from slide to slide.

• GRID LAYOUTS FOR A COHESIVE FEED
Multi-post grids that span several photos, giving your feed a structured, unified look. Your profile is a portfolio and SCRL helps it look like one.

• MORE THAN 10 PHOTOS IN ONE POST
Break the limitations of traditional posts & Instagram layouts. With SCRL, you can add more than 10 photos in a single post, providing more room for your creativity and storytelling.

Design your way with our freeform canvas. Zoom in and out to perfect every detail or get an overview of your entire project. Create a layout that’s uniquely yours. 

• STICKERS & OVERLAYS
A growing library of overlays and stickers to add texture, depth, and detail to any design. Whatever your style, you’ll find elements that complement your collages and carousels perfectly.

• DIRECT POSTING TO INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK
When it's ready, it goes live - exactly as designed. No exporting, no re-uploading.

• WHERE PROFESSIONAL CONTENT GETS MADE
From property listings to campaign launches, social media schedules to client pitches - SCRL handles the volume without sacrificing the craft.

• SCRL PREMIUM
Every template, every layout, every tool, plus features built for work that demands more. Monthly and yearly plans, starting with a free 7-day trial.

SCRL is trusted by Grammy Award-winning artists, NBA players, and major international music festivals. We’ve been featured numerous times in the App Store and recognized by top industry publications:

"14 Best Apps For Instagram Collages" - Hootsuite

it.name: Locket Widget
it.d:
Locket is a widget that shows live photos from your best friends, right to your Home Screen. You and your best friends will see new pictures from each other every time you unlock your phone. It’s a little glimpse of what everyone’s up to throughout the day.
 
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add the Locket widget to your Home Screen
2. When a friend sends you a photo, it instantly appears on your Locket widget!
3. To share a pic back, tap into the widget, take a pic with the camera, and then hit send! It appears right on your friends’ Home Screens
 
FOR YOUR CLOSE FRIENDS
• To keep things friendly, you can only have 20 friends on the app.
• On Locket, there’s no worrying about follower count, just add your best friends and family and live in the moment.
• With Locket, you’re able to be real and share photos to the people that matter.
 
REACT TO FRIENDS' PHOTOS
• Send a Locket reaction to your friends to let them know you saw their image.
• They’ll get a notification and you’ll love watching the emojis rain down on your photo.
• We don’t count or track the reactions, so you can be real and authentic without worrying about likes and filters like other platforms.
 
BUILD A HISTORY OF YOUR LOCKETS
• As you and friends snap Lockets, you’ll build up a history of all images sent.
• Share them out as photos or use our video recap feature to stitch together the memories of you and your friends, capturing those “love it” moments.
• Locket will also make you a recap video at the end of every month with all of the photos you've shared.
 
ADD LOCKETS FOR YOUR BESTIES AND CRUSHES
• Decorate your home screen with more photos and images dedicated to your crush or your bestie
• Add the “Crush” or “Best Friend” picture widget, and see photos only from that person. Plus, you can send images just to that person too!
 
Here’s what our users say:
 
“I love this app because I get to share cute pictures to my friends” - HI
“AMAZING SO WORTH IT” - rikkibear29282902
“Best app made this year” - johanjodel_
 
Plus, users love our camera (so you’ll love the photos!) - @sonnielove3 on Twitter even said, “It’s sum about that locket camera”
 
Download the free app! We’re keeping Locket free so you can send photos to the people that matter (friends, family, bestie, etc.). With Locket, your phone will feel like it’s bringing you closer to your best friends.
 
Please write to us at team@locketcamera.com. Thanks for having Locket on your Home Screen!

it.name: X
it.d:
X (formerly Twitter) is a social media app where you can follow breaking news, live events, and trending topics as they happen. Sports, tech, music, politics: whatever you're into, the conversation starts here, raw and unfiltered.

It's also a place to be heard. Post your take on the day's news, go live, and grow an audience for whatever you create. Millions of people come to X every day to find out what's happening and talk about it.


WHAT YOU CAN DO ON X

- Follow breaking news – Get news from around the world before it hits the headlines, with real-time updates on trending topics and viral conversations.
- Post to a global community – Share your thoughts, photos, and videos. Join millions of users shaping public dialogue across social, cultural, and political conversations.
- Ask Grok – Grok is the AI assistant powered by X's real-time data. Ask Grok to summarize trending news, explain videos, or give you more context about posts. Grok also powers the photo and video editing tools in the app.
- Create original videos – The built-in Video Editor and Recorder lets you shoot, add multi-language captions, apply green screen effects, and post pro-level content directly in the app.
- Go live on video – Stream a concert, a live game, or your thoughts on a hot topic, and keep your audience engaged with enhanced livestream tools.
- Watch video and podcasts – From live breaking news and sports clips to podcasts and gaming sessions up to 3 hours long. Many of the world's leading voices in comedy, gaming, podcasting, and politics share their content on X.
- Host live audio with Spaces – Spaces is X's audio feature for hosting discussions, holding interviews, or starting your next live podcast.
- Message privately – Connect and chat with friends, followers, customers, or collaborators through Direct Messages.
- Pin Custom Timelines – Custom Timelines are Grok-powered topic feeds you can pin for the topics you follow most.
- Turn on Priority Notifications – Priority Notifications surface your key interactions first.
- Open your History tab – The History tab is one unified place for your bookmarks, likes, videos, and articles.
- Subscribe to X Premium – X Premium unlocks a blue checkmark, boosted visibility, prioritized replies, fewer ads, longer videos, and post editing. It also gives you creator revenue sharing and the ability to offer exclusive content to subscribers.

WHO X IS FOR

X is for people who follow breaking news and live events in real time, for sports, tech, music, and politics fans, for creators and podcasters who stream and create original video content for an audience, and for anyone building a community around gaming, entertainment, crypto, entrepreneurship, or tech.

WHY X?

In a world of constant change, X is your real-time source to stay ahead of the curve, connect with people, explore diverse perspectives, and create standout content. From breaking live news and trending memes to top podcasts, live streams, and original videos from your favorite creators, X brings it all together in one powerful social experience.

Learn a new language, chess & more with the world's most downloaded education app! Duolingo is the fun, free app for learning 40+ languages through quick, bite-sized lessons. Practice speaking, reading, listening & writing to build your vocabulary & grammar skills.

And now, you can learn CHESS on Duolingo! Whether you're a total beginner or looking to level up your game, you'll love learning chess the Duolingo way. Play matches and fun chess lessons for all levels, no matter the language - chess, ajedrez, xadrez, schach, Шахматы, الشطرنج.

• Chess: Learn the moves, level up your game & play matches in our Chess course. Learn the basics, solve fun chess puzzles & improve your strategy with guided lessons. Whether you're new to chess or already play, our course is designed to help you have fun and build real skills. Checkmate!

• Math: Forget lectures and math worksheets! Built by learning experts, our Math course makes math feel like a game. Boost learning and fight the summer slide with standards-aligned math lessons for elementary school, middle school, and high school students.

• Music: Learn how to read music & play songs in our Music course, no instrument needed! Using an on-screen keyboard, you'll learn bit-by-bit.

Whether you're learning a language for travel, school, career or your brain health, you'll love learning with Duolingo.


Why Duolingo?

• Duolingo is fun & effective. Game-like language lessons & fun characters help you build speaking, reading, listening, & writing skills, plus enjoy fun chess & competitive online chess in one app.

• Duolingo works. Designed by learning experts, Duolingo has a science-based teaching methodology proven to foster long-term knowledge retention across language lessons & chess lessons alike.

• Track your progress. Work toward your learning goals with playful rewards & achievements when you make practicing language lessons or chess online part of your daily habit.

• Join millions of learners. Stay motivated with competitive Leaderboards as you learn languages & play chess online alongside our global community.

• Every course is free. Learn Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Irish, Danish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Esperanto, Polish, Greek, Hungarian, Norwegian, Hebrew, Welsh, Arabic, Latin, Hawaiian, Scottish Gaelic, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, English, & even High Valyrian! And now, learn Math, Music & improve your Chess skills with fun, bite-sized lessons.
